department: Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
objective: To increase women's participation in agriculture through technical training, formation of women farmer self-help groups, savings, internal lending and support for income-generating activities.
main_benefits: Formation of women farmer self-help groups
Encouragement for small businesses and income-generating activities
Group-based discussion and support for members' problems
eligibility: The official document shown states that trained small and marginal women farmers can form self-help groups. Members should have broadly similar economic and social conditions and similar livelihood or occupation.
group_structure: Approximately 10 to 15 women farmers form a self-help group.
application_process: Interested women farmers can contact the concerned Rural Agricultural Extension Officer or Agriculture Development Officer for participation and group formation. The document describes meetings, group formation and record-keeping procedures.
official_source: Madhya Pradesh Department of Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development
source_note: The screenshots supplied by the user are from the official MP Agriculture Department website (mpkrishi.mp.gov.in). They show the department document describing women farmer self-help groups, including group formation, member conditions, savings, internal loans, bank loans, records and group activities.
